theorems.name: Submission.aemeasurable_starProjection_of_aemeasurable_norm_sq
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (K : Euclid P → Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), (∀ u : Euclid P, AEMeasurable (fun x => ‖(K x).starProjection u‖ ^ 2) μ) → AEMeasurable (fun x => (K x).starProjection) μ
